info.title: InvoiceFlow API
info.description: Money is always integer minor units. Authenticated routes need a Supabase access token. Cross-business ids answer 404. Generated by api/scripts/build-docs.ts.

Business.description: Business profile, defaults and numbering settings.

BusinessUpdate.description: Any subset of the business fields (unknown fields are rejected).

CustomerInput.description: At least one of firstName, lastName, companyName is required.

InvoiceInput.description: Totals are never accepted; the server computes them. Unknown fields are ignored.

value.description: Basis points for percent, minor units for fixed

displayStatus.description: status, or "overdue" (derived from due date and balance)

EstimateInput.description: Same as InvoiceInput, with expiryDate instead of dueDate.

displayStatus.description: status, or "expired" (derived from the expiry date)

amountMinor.description: Omit to pay the full balance; smaller values are partial payments

currencies.description: Default currency first. Never summed across currencies.
